core_design_summary: Call-form predicate DSL (zero parser change) + host-observed debug-flag SSBO injected only under --debug + atomicOr idempotent bitmask + golden-identity byte-identity gate (AT-2838/2866) + at_1115 device-keyed ULP widening. All four pillars STAND; the r2 changes are surgical.

fixes.title: OpAtomicOr scope vs emitted memory model
fixes.r1_state: spec said scope Device unconditionally + 'no new OpCapability'; INVALID on coopmat kernels (emit.rs:152-162 emits MemoryModel::Vulkan, where Device scope requires VulkanMemoryModelDeviceScope). Preconditions ARE lowered on coopmat kernels, so the bad leg is real.
fixes.r2_resolution: §2 + §4 + §11(emit.rs): scope keyed on the emitted memory model via the SAME uses_coopmat predicate — Scope::QueueFamily under MemoryModel::Vulkan (coopmat; needs nothing beyond the already-present VulkanMemoryModel), Scope::Device under GLSL450 (non-coopmat; valid with Shader alone). Net capability set == baseline on BOTH legs. AT-2867 now spirv-vals a GLSL450 AND a coopmat precondition kernel and asserts caps gain nothing.

fixes.title: Postcondition gate unsound for guarded/conditional writes
fixes.r1_state: §5 required only that a BufferWrite{buf,gid(0)} EXISTS; body.rs:579/850 support guarded `if(i<n){buf[i]=…}`, so a guarded write passed the gate but the exit read `buf[gid(0)]` on padding threads is OOB / reads-unwritten ⇒ spurious violation or device fault.
fixes.r2_resolution: §5 condition 3 now requires the HirStmt::BufferWrite{buffer_binding==buf, index==gid(0)} to UNCONDITIONALLY DOMINATE exit, defined as a CONSERVATIVE SYNTACTIC check: the write appears at the kernel body top level, NOT nested inside any HirStmt::If/ForRange/While — explicitly NO dataflow analysis in v1. Reuses the proven body.rs:836 stmt_reassigns_binding_unconditionally discipline. Guarded/loop-nested writes ⇒ HirWarning::PostconditionNotLowerable, compile succeeds, no unguarded exit read emitted. (r1 also mislabeled the node 'IndexAssign'; corrected to the actual HirStmt::BufferWrite.)

fixes.title: Descriptor plumbing for the injected binding
fixes.r1_state: under-specified against how the runtime sizes DSL/pool.
fixes.r2_resolution: §7 states explicitly the flag binding is APPENDED to binding_plan.buffers under --debug, so all four derivations agree: SPIR-V decoration (set0/binding=num_user_buffers), DSL build, pool sizing (context.rs:1636 uses .len()), bind loop (context.rs:1628). Not a detached metadata field. AT-2867 asserts pool==layout==bind==N+1.

fixes.title: Host-readback NonCoherent invalidate (fail-closed)
fixes.r1_state: §2 said fence makes writes host-visible; OMITTED vkInvalidateMappedMemoryRanges — fail-OPEN on non-HOST_COHERENT devices (silently misses violations).
fixes.r2_resolution: §2 + §7 route the flag readback through the existing NonCoherent invalidate path (buffers.rs Coherency::NonCoherent), honoring context.rs force_noncoherent_staging / AXC_FORCE_NONCOHERENT_STAGING — same path as user outputs; fails CLOSED. New AT-2879 exercises AXC_FORCE_NONCOHERENT_STAGING=1 and asserts a real violation is still observed.

fixes.title: Pin %bad = OpLogicalNot(OpFOrd*) NaN-fail-loud form
fixes.r2_resolution: §4 pins the exact form: FOrd-family compare + OpLogicalNot of the RESULT (never FUnord*, never inverting the operator) so a NaN operand ⇒ compare false ⇒ %bad true ⇒ violation FLAGGED. New AT-2878: a NaN scalar precondition operand sets the violation bit.

fixes.title: Observational-only (NO early return) as an explicit design rule
fixes.r2_resolution: §2 states: violated condition does NOT short-circuit (body runs with offending inputs); each check emits its own OpSelectionMerge (structured CF); postcondition insertion assumes a SINGLE trailing OpReturn (deferred multi-return). Sidesteps BarrierInDivergentContext by construction.

fixes.title: at_1115 keys on 'llvmpipe' substring; within_ulp_f32 untouched; no >64 clamp
fixes.r2_resolution: §10: device match = name.to_ascii_lowercase().contains("llvmpipe") (never 'lavapipe', which never appears). within_ulp_f32 is NOT modified (M3.16 reuses it at fixed 4 ULP at bench_variant.rs:496-498); tolerance threaded only through check_saxpy/check_vector_add. Ceiling rule: measured_max forcing >64 ⇒ milestone FAILS/re-measures, no silent clamp. AT-2876 adds a guard leg proving a non-llvmpipe name stays 4 ULP.

fixes.title: skip_serializing_if so release metadata has no debug_checks key
fixes.r2_resolution: §7 + §11: field is #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]; release JSON omits the key entirely (not "debug_checks":null). AT-2868 asserts absence under release.

fixes.title: Pin injected binding index; assert flag bytes directly; @strict release cross-check
fixes.r2_resolution: AT-2867 pins injected index == num_user_buffers; AT-2870..2873 assert flag-buffer words == exact expected bitmask (not only the typed error); AT-2874 adds the @strict-release-byte-unchanged cross-check.
